title: The Green Secret of Mars
content:
In the year 2189, humans had built small cities on Mars. The planet was still cold and dry, but new technology allowed people to live there.

Leo was a young engineer who worked at a research station far from the main city. One morning, he received an urgent message from the station's director.

— Leo, we have a problem. The oxygen system in Sector Seven has stopped working.

Leo quickly took his tools and left the station. On his way to Sector Seven, he noticed something strange. A small green plant was growing near an old building.

He had never seen a plant growing outside the protected areas of Mars.

When he reached the building, he found the oxygen system completely frozen. He needed to enter the old storage room to find a replacement part, but the metal door was stuck.

Leo picked up an emergency axe from his vehicle.

— I hope this still works.

He used the axe to break the damaged lock and opened the door. Inside, he found the replacement part and several old machines.

While looking for the part, Leo discovered an old computer. It contained information from the first human missions to Mars. According to the files, scientists had once experimented with plants that could survive in the Martian environment.

Leo looked again at the small green plant outside.

— You can't be one of those plants, can you?

He carefully collected a small sample and returned to the station.

The scientists examined it and discovered something incredible. The plant could produce oxygen and survive with very little water. Even more importantly, it could grow in the Martian soil.

The discovery changed everything.

Months later, hundreds of these plants were growing around the research station. The air became cleaner, and small green areas appeared across the red landscape.

Leo often walked outside and looked at the first plant he had discovered.

Mars was still a difficult place to live, but it no longer looked completely lifeless.

For the first time, the humans on Mars could imagine a future surrounded by trees, plants, and fresh air.
